packet.prompt: Return a CSV with one row per candidate implementation or migration record that could make RWIL/WIT/EAVT chain-carried. Columns: candidate_name, exact_role, chain_carried_data, offchain_data, migration_status (implemented|partial|superseded|uncertain), evidence_path, exact_evidence, contradicting_evidence, and cheapest falsifying observation. Do not infer absence from naming; include differently named candidates and explicitly separate source claims from deployed/receiver evidence.
